caption: The drawing consists of a collection of abstract, geometric, and organic shapes arranged loosely in the center of a textured rectangular area. The background is filled with a dense pattern of small brown dots, while the objects themselves are outlined in either red or blue-gray, with some filled in or crosshatched in the same colors. The shapes include a variety of forms: several spiky circular or starburst shapes, elongated leaf- or pod-like forms with interior geometric patterns, a few smaller circles with crisscross or checkerboard interiors, a bold red cross-like structure with rounded arms, and several abstract forms resembling segmented capsules or enclosed nets. The composition is largely made up of the red, blue-gray, and off-white color palette, with the brown background providing contrast to the more vibrant shapes. The edges of the central design gradually dissipate into the background, with the densest arrangement of shapes toward the middle of the drawing.
title: Petroglyphs
